embeds.title: BLHA LINEUP ALERTS
embeds.description: A daily heads-up before games start when a lineup can be improved.

fields.name: WHAT IT CATCHES
fields.value: A player in your active lineup has no NHL game today while one of your reserves who can fill that slot does play.

fields.name: WHO GETS ALERTS
fields.value: Owners who opt in. Ask the Commissioner to add you; the alert mentions you once a day at most, around 3:00 PM ET.

fields.name: YOUR CALL
fields.value: Alerts are a reminder, not a rule. Lineups are yours to set in Fantrax (9.1).

fields.name: DISCUSSION
fields.value: Owners can react here but not post. Talk about it in **💬│gm-lounge**.
